findings.body: The helper removes a standalone `811` from the unsafe-digit scan. For example, `CVV 811` passes validation and is returned as a valid variant, despite containing a three-digit value that looks like card details. The test that allows product names containing `811` does not cover this context. The exception needs to distinguish a product name from card details before add and edit use this helper.
findings.title: Not done: Refuse CVV-like variants
